description: A complete feature folder: every task has a brief, nothing is cut, no warnings. T004 is the [P]-versus-brief conflict case.

tasks.title: Session store, types and expiry fixtures
acceptance: Given a store and `now = 0`, When `create("u1", 0)` is called with `sessionMinutes: 30`, Then the session has a 32-character hex id and `expiresAt` of 1,800,000.
Given a session that expires at 1,800,000, When `get(id, 1_800_000)` is called, Then it returns `null` and a second `get` at any time also returns `null`.
Given a session that expires at 1,800,000, When `get(id, 1_799_999)` is called, Then the session is returned unchanged.
Given the fixture table `test/fixtures/sessions.json`, When the unit tests run, Then every `get` case passes and every `touch` case is reported as skipped, not failed.

tasks.title: Login and logout endpoints with the login page
acceptance: Given a registered user, When `POST /api/login` is called with the right password, Then the response is 204 and sets an `HttpOnly` `sid` cookie whose value decodes to a session in the store.
Given a wrong password or an unknown user, When `POST /api/login` is called, Then the response is 401 with body `{ "error": "invalid credentials" }` and no cookie is set.
Given a signed-in user, When `POST /api/logout` is called, Then the response is 204, the session is removed from the store and the cookie is cleared.
Given a browser, When it opens `/login`, Then it sees a form with fields `user` and `password` and a submit button labelled "Sign in".

tasks.title: Session refresh near expiry
acceptance: Given `sessionMinutes: 30`, `refreshWindowMinutes: 5` and a session expiring at 1,800,000, When `touch(id, 1_500_001)` is called, Then `expiresAt` becomes 3,300,001.
Given the same session, When `touch(id, 1_500_000)` is called, Then `expiresAt` stays 1,800,000 and the returned session is the stored one.
Given the same session, When `touch(id, 1_800_000)` is called, Then the result is `null` and the session is gone from the store.
Given a signed-in request inside the refresh window, When `GET /api/me` is handled, Then the body's `expiresAt` equals the refreshed value and the `sid` cookie is unchanged.
Given the fixture table `test/fixtures/sessions.json`, When the unit tests run, Then every `touch` case passes and none is skipped.

tasks.title: Auth middleware for protected routes
acceptance: Given no cookie, When `GET /api/me` is requested, Then the response is 401 `{ "error": "not signed in" }`.
Given a cookie whose signature does not verify, When any protected route is requested, Then the response is 401 and the store is not consulted.
Given a valid session, When `GET /api/me` is requested, Then the response is 200 and `req.session` was set for the handler.
Given a valid session inside the refresh window, When any protected route is requested, Then `refreshIfDue` was called once with the session id.
Given `/login`, `/api/login`, `/healthz` and `/static/app.css`, When requested without a cookie, Then none of them is answered 401 by the middleware.

conflicts.decision: T004: tasks.md marks [P] but the brief says parallel: false; the brief wins

lines: | REQ-AUTH-03 | A session used within the refresh window before its expiry MUST be extended by the session lifetime from that request. | new |

- `REQ-AUTH-03`: Given a session expiring at 1,800,000 and a 5-minute window, When it is used at 1,500,001, Then its expiry becomes 3,300,001; When it is used at 1,500,000, Then its expiry is unchanged.
| REQ-AUTH-04 | Every route outside the public list MUST answer 401 to a request without a valid session. | new |
- A cookie whose signature does not verify is treated as missing, with no hint of forgery (REQ-AUTH-04).
- `REQ-AUTH-04`: Given no cookie, When `GET /api/me` is requested, Then the response is 401 `{ "error": "not signed in" }`.
